Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation

TIGA — Technology Assessment and Farm Household Segmentation for Inclusive Poverty Reduction

TIGA — Technology Assessment and Farm Household Segmentation for Inclusive Poverty Reduction

ROLE

Senior Research Associate

PERIOD / PORTFOLIO

January 2012 – January 2013

GEOGRAPHY

Bangladesh

THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

Phase 1 ex-ante assessment; Phase 2 RCT (RATIOS)

The question
behind the work.

Enhance the inclusion of all small farming communities in agricultural technology innovation by improving understanding of the interactions between technology needs, farming systems, ecological resources and poverty characteristics.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Assessed (ex-ante) the likely impact of major agricultural crop innovations and productivity growth programs on workforce productivity and livelihoods across strata of the poor.

  2. 02

    Developed a rollout strategy for major innovations based on the assessment.

  3. 03

    Designed project interventions and MRM systems; prepared questionnaires and methodology for baseline and endline surveys; conducted survey and data analysis.

  4. 04

    Presented at an international seminar and co-authored a book chapter.

  5. 05

    Supported the team leader in designing a 4-year intervention programme using RCT methodology with ZEF, University of Bonn.
